configuration.instrumentation: Normal torch API coverage, unfiltered argument/return metadata, use_full_instr=False, descriptors disabled, no proxy/model tracking, no tensor-value dump, interval1,warmup0

limits: Two alternating unprofiled pairs and one distinct profile per workload; three steps including first-step effects; no steady-state or confidence claim
Tiny CPU training workloads; no GPU/distributed/online-checking overhead claim
cProfile slows Python-heavy paths; its percentages are profiled main-thread time and cannot be applied directly to unprofiled wall time
Profile excludes setup,start_step,loss extraction,state hashing,background writer and shutdown; unprofiled training wall includes start_step and wrapper-disable assignment
Raw traces across fresh processes contain different timestamps and identities; no normalization or trace-equivalence claim
Current full-API metadata collection, not selective checking mode or full tensor-value capture
No production optimization or speedup candidate was implemented

data.ordering: first samples in IDX order; no shuffle

profile.denominator: cProfile total time over the three training steps, main thread only

data.adaptation: Whitespace tokenization plus <eos>; vocabulary and tensors are bounded to the chosen prefix, unlike the full benchmark corpus.
